metadata.description: Post-restart phase for the offline PNG round trip: reopen the existing saved project, verify the shot and previous render history, then edit and save a new revision.
metadata.name: desktop-offline-png-roundtrip-resume

evaluate.expression: (() => {const name=document.querySelector('[data-testid="shot-name-input"]');const history=document.querySelectorAll('.shot-render-job').length;if(name?.value!=='Offline still')throw new Error('Expected saved shot did not reopen');if(history<1)throw new Error('Earlier render history did not reopen');return {shotName:name.value,renderHistoryCount:history};})()

(() => {const name=document.querySelector('[data-testid="shot-name-input"]');const history=document.querySelectorAll('.shot-render-job').length;if(name?.value!=='Offline still edited'||history<1)throw new Error('New revision or original render history is missing');return {savedName:name.value,renderHistoryPreserved:history>0};})()
